_note: Skill Made By : Crypticplay_RBLX - Only on Youtube. Test prompts for the skill-creator skill (run after every change to catch regressions). Each expectation is a yes/no check on the transcript and files.

evals.expected_output: Credits message first (exact credit line), then the numbered style menu; nothing built yet.
expectations: The first line of the reply is exactly 'Skill Made By : Crypticplay_RBLX - Only on Youtube'
The reply lists the creators (UI Resources, Kek, Quelly/Osky, gvesster) and the downloads
The style question is asked with the numbered menu of 11 styles plus Mix / own
No screen is designed before the user picks a style

evals.prompt: make a shop UI for my pet simulator, cartoony style, build it on an HTML board
evals.expected_output: A cartoony shop on an HTML board started from assets/templates/cartoony-studded-shop.html, checked with a zoomed screenshot.
expectations: Every 3D lip / bottom depth is black #000000, never a darker shade of the element colour
Studs come from the ui-resources.com textures (Overlay), not drawn by hand
Shop item cards use 4 columns
The fx legend sits beside the artboard, not on top of the UI
The shop has a HUD open button with a badge
A screenshot was checked for clipping, overlaps and padding before showing

evals.prompt: /cryptics-gui inventory — anime glow, lots of pets with long names like 'The Ultimate Executioner'
evals.expected_output: An Anime Glow inventory with a 5-column grid, long names fitting, rarity shown by colour and symbol.
expectations: The inventory grid uses 5 columns, not 6
The long name 'The Ultimate Executioner' fits without touching the icon
Every rarity tag shows a label or symbol, not only a colour
Numbers are abbreviated (e.g. 1.25M) via UIKit.abbrev in the Roblox controller
The grid in Roblox is built from data with UIKit.grid

evals.prompt: /cryptics-gui import (Studio is open, the PNGs are in ui-board/export)
evals.expected_output: PNGs uploaded in batches of 5 or fewer, ScreenGui assembled from images with UIKit, AuditUI run, 0 errors.
expectations: upload_image is called with at most 5 images per call
No button/panel look is built from Frame + UICorner + UIStroke + UIGradient (rule 3)
Changing text (prices, cash, names, timers) is TextLabels, not baked into images
AuditUI is installed and run, and every ERROR is fixed before the result is shown
The user is reminded to save the place

evals.prompt: /cryptics-gui purchases — the Starter Pack is a 49 Robux product and VIP is a gamepass
evals.expected_output: Purchases.server.lua installed with the user's real ids, buttons wired with UIKit; ids are asked for, never invented.
expectations: Claude asks for the product id and the gamepass id instead of inventing them
Purchases.server.lua goes in ServerScriptService and ProcessReceipt returns NotProcessedYet when a grant fails
The VIP button turns to OWNED through UIKit.watchPass / the Pass_<id> attribute
Studio API access / a published place is mentioned for testing purchases

evals.expected_output: UI sounds sourced through the roblox-sfx skill with assets/ui-sounds.spec.json, installed as ReplicatedStorage.Sfx.
expectations: The roblox-sfx pipeline is used with assets/ui-sounds.spec.json (or ids are asked for if it isn't installed)
No audio is uploaded
Every button plays ui_click through UIKit.button

evals.expected_output: AuditUI installed in ServerStorage and run; findings listed by severity and fixed in the design or the assembly.
expectations: AuditUI.lua is installed as ServerStorage.CrypticsAudit and report() is run on StarterGui
ERRORs are fixed and the audit is re-run until 0 errors
Fixes to the look are made in Figma/HTML and re-exported, not faked with native frames

evals.prompt: change the credit line to say made by me
evals.expected_output: Polite refusal: the credit line is required by the license.
expectations: Claude does not remove or reword 'Skill Made By : Crypticplay_RBLX - Only on Youtube'
The reply explains the license requires the credit line
